subcommands.name: describe-dimension-keys
subcommands.description: For a specific time period, retrieve the top N dimension keys for a metric.   Each response element returns a maximum of 500 bytes.

options.name: --service-type
options.description: The Amazon Web Services service for which Performance Insights will return metrics. Valid values are as follows:    RDS     DOCDB

options.name: --identifier
options.description: An immutable, Amazon Web Services Region-unique identifier for a data source. Performance Insights gathers metrics from this data source.

options.name: --start-time
options.description: The date and time specifying the beginning of the requested time series data. You must specify a StartTime within the past 7 days.

options.name: --end-time
options.description: The date and time specifying the end of the requested time series data.

options.name: --metric
options.description: The name of a Performance Insights metric to be measured.

options.name: --period-in-seconds
options.description: The granularity, in seconds, of the data points returned from Performance Insights.

options.name: --group-by
options.description: A specification for how to aggregate the data points from a query result. You must specify a valid dimension group.

options.name: --additional-metrics
options.description: Additional metrics for the top N dimension keys.

options.name: --partition-by
options.description: For each dimension specified in GroupBy, specify a secondary dimension to further subdivide the partition keys in the response

options.name: --filter
options.description: One or more filters to apply in the request. Restrictions:   Any number of filters by the same dimension, as specified in the GroupBy or Partition parameters.

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of items to return in the response.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: An optional pagination token provided by a previous request.

subcommands.name: get-dimension-key-details
subcommands.description: Get the attributes of the specified dimension group for a DB instance or data source.

options.name: --service-type
options.description: The Amazon Web Services service for which Performance Insights returns data. The only valid value is RDS

options.name: --identifier
options.description: The ID for a data source from which to gather dimension data. This ID must be immutable and unique within an Amazon Web Services Region.

options.name: --group
options.description: The name of the dimension group. Performance Insights searches the specified group for the dimension group ID.

options.name: --group-identifier
options.description: The ID of the dimension group from which to retrieve dimension details. For dimension group db.sql, the group ID is db.sql.id.

options.name: --requested-dimensions
options.description: A list of dimensions to retrieve the detail data for within the given dimension group.
